name: c
prompt: Create an edge-to-edge square native LCD settings choice-editor concept for Felucca, a musical instrument with a 240 by 240 logical pixel display. Render only the finished flat screen, with crisp readable text and no device, browser or decorative setting. The two references contribute native M8Stealth bitmap lettering, the AMBER palette and dark utilitarian surfaces, not the old layout. This concept explores a dedicated page for comparing named alternatives. Its compact top path is DISPLAY / LEDS with HOME CLOSE; the page title LEDS and short description KEY LED BRIGHTNESS establish context. Show all six real choices as a vertically aligned, uniformly sized list: OFF, DIM LO, DIM HI, INV, INV LO, INV HI. DIM HI is the currently applied choice: mark it with a small explicit solid square and the word SET. INV LO is the focused candidate, distinguished by a high-contrast full-width selection band. Preserve a clear visual distinction between the applied value and the candidate. A quiet footer says CURRENT DIM HI and PREVIEW INV LO, then physical-button hints OCT- BACK and OCT+ APPLY. These hints describe a proposed interaction, not current firmware. No giant number, sliders, illustrations or instrument parameter bank. Prioritize comparing the choice names and knowing whether a change has actually been applied.
